Octo Telematics SpA Appoints New Chief Operations Officer to Drive Growth

Octo Telematics SpA, a leading player in Italy’s telecommunications sector, has announced the appointment of Claudia Rinaldi as its new Chief Operations Officer (COO), effective immediately. The Rome-based company, best known for its telematics solutions for insurance and fleet management, said the move reflects its ongoing commitment to operational excellence and strategic growth.

Rinaldi brings over 20 years of experience in operations and digital transformation, having previously served in senior leadership roles at several technology firms in Italy and across Europe. She will report directly to CEO Marco Bellini and oversee Octo Telematics SpA’s global operations, including service delivery, customer support, and process optimization.

“We are delighted to welcome Claudia to our executive team,” said Bellini in a statement. “Her track record in leading operational improvements and her deep understanding of the telecommunications landscape make her the ideal candidate to support our ambitious expansion plans.”

Industry analysts have noted that Octo Telematics SpA has seen steady growth in recent years, particularly in the connected vehicle and usage-based insurance segments. According to the Italian Association of Digital Mobility, the domestic telematics market grew by 7.5% last year, with Octo maintaining a strong market share. The company’s recent expansion into new European markets has been viewed positively by investors.

Rinaldi expressed enthusiasm about her new role: “I am honored to join Octo Telematics SpA at such an exciting time. The company’s innovative approach to data-driven mobility solutions positions it well for continued success. I look forward to working closely with our talented teams to enhance operational efficiency and deliver value to our clients.”

The appointment has also been welcomed by industry observers. Giovanni Sartori, a telecoms analyst at ItalTrade Insights, commented, “Rinaldi’s experience in managing complex operations will be valuable as Octo continues to scale up its services and responds to increasing customer demand.”

Octo Telematics SpA confirmed that Rinaldi will focus initially on optimizing processes and supporting the integration of new digital platforms, in line with the company’s strategic roadmap for 2024.
